ios.desc:
FishPal helps you plan the trip, stay connected while you’re on the water, and learn what worked when the day is done.

Before you head out, use FishPal to organize spots, check conditions, and decide where to fish. During the trip, track your route, log catches, and share your live outing with friends or family so they can follow along from shore. Afterward, FishPal turns your catches, weather, locations, notes, and timing into a clearer picture of what helped you succeed.

It is more than a catch log. FishPal becomes your private fishing map, trip journal, and pattern-finding companion, built around the way you actually fish.

What you can do with FishPal:
- Navigate to saved fishing spots and waters
- Share live trips with friends and family
- Log catches with photos, lures, notes, and conditions
- Track weather, location, routes, and trip history
- Review what worked across spots, timing, and conditions
- Keep your fishing memories organized in one private place

Whether you fish from shore, boat, river, lake, or coast, FishPal helps every trip become easier to remember and more useful for the next one.

FISHPAL PREMIUM
Advanced spot and waterbody analysis, deeper insights, expanded tracking, and the full FishPal experience are available with FishPal Premium.
